summary: Tri-State Generation & Transmission Association filed an 8-K to report entry into a $650 million second amended and restated secured revolving credit facility with eight lenders, including National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation as sole arranger and administrative agent. This replaces a $520 million facility and is used for working capital, capital expenditures, and general corporate purposes. The facility matures April 21, 2031, and bears interest at Term SOFR or alternate base rates plus margins based on credit ratings. No special situation event occurs; this is a routine credit facility amendment with no change in control, acquisition, or activist involvement.
